integrity: Complete self-contained proof, explicit realizing sketch and independently reproducible exact-polynomial and matrix-norm checks. Bibliographic priority may remain uncertain; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic two-column existence family; the two-turn effect may have arbitrarily small amplitude and no typicality, large slowdown, or probability lower bound is asserted. title: A two-turn conditioning path for arbitrarily accurate reused ridge sketches
